segments.text: 1. BAptiſm is an Ordinance of the New Teſtament, ordained by Jeſus Chriſt, to be unto the party Baptized, a ſign of his fellowſhip with him, in his death, and reſurrection; of his being engrafted into him; of remiſſion of ſins; and of his giving up unto God through Jeſus Chriſt to live and walk in newneſs of Life.
2. Thoſe who do actually profeſſe repentance towards God, faith in, and obedience, to our Lord Jeſus, are the only proper ſubjects of this ordinance.
3. The outward element to be uſed in this ordinance is water, wherein the party is to be baptized, in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.
4. Immerſion, or dipping of the perſon in water, is neceſſary to the due adminiſtration of this ordinance.
